-- Connection = Data_Staging

SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE	@DeleteITEMID TABLE(
	[ITEMID]	NVARCHAR(40)	NULL);

INSERT INTO @DeleteITEMID(
	[ITEMID])
-- Delete the following records
-- Records with different verion
SELECT	[s].[ITEMID]
FROM	[ax].[INVENTTABLE] [s] INNER JOIN [dbo].[ztmp_INVENTTABLE_IDs] [a]
	ON (
		([s].[ITEMID] = [a].[ITEMID])
	AND
		([s].[PARTITION] = [a].[PARTITION])
	AND
		([s].[DATAAREAID] = [a].[DATAAREAID])
	)
WHERE	[a].[RECVERSION] != [s].[RECVERSION];

INSERT INTO @DeleteITEMID(
	[ITEMID])
-- Records that exist in Staging but no longer exist in AX
SELECT	[ITEMID]
FROM	[ax].[INVENTTABLE] 
	EXCEPT
SELECT	[ITEMID]
FROM	[dbo].[ztmp_INVENTTABLE_IDs];

DELETE
FROM	[ax].[INVENTTABLE]
WHERE	[ITEMID] IN (SELECT [ITEMID] FROM @DeleteITEMID);
